nameOfQualification: Customer Care Sr. Executive (Voice and Non- Voice)
description: The individual in this job role is responsible for collecting payments over the phone, chat, or email and converting customer inquiries into sales. They make outbound tele sales calls to promote products or services and close deals. Additionally, they handle customer queries remotely, ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction. This role requires excellent communication skills and the ability to manage customer interactions effectively to drive sales and payment collection.
